mapper.select: SELECT co.*, u.real_name AS patient_name, u.phone AS patient_phone, u.gender AS patient_gender, cp.name AS package_name, d.real_name AS doctor_name FROM check_order co LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON co.patient_id = u.id LEFT JOIN check_package cp ON co.package_id = cp.id LEFT JOIN sys_user d ON co.doctor_id = d.id WHERE co.id = #{orderId} AND co.deleted = 0
